description: This file contains utility functions and macros for quantized tensor operations in QNNPACK, including shift operations and requantization functions, with platform-specific handling and safety checks.

methods.name: asr_s32
methods.description: Performs arithmetic right shift on 32-bit integers with platform-specific workaround.

methods.name: asr_s64
methods.description: Performs arithmetic right shift on 64-bit integers with platform-specific workaround.

methods.name: pytorch_scalar_requantize_precise
methods.description: Performs precise requantization of a 32-bit integer value to an 8-bit quantized value with scaling, zero point, and clamping.
